job.title: CFCO 1534 - Supply Chain Technology Lead @ Softobiz Technologies (TS, IN)
job.description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Technology Lead**
===========================================

Work Location: Hyderabad

Position: Fulltime

**Summary of role**
===================

The Supply Chain Technology Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for the applications, workflows and integrations that support the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) ecosystem. The role owns day-to-day technical delivery and continuous improvement across ERP applications and partner integrations, working closely with Finance, Procurement, Operations, technology teams and vendors.

  

**Core activities**
===================

* Act as the day-to-day technical owner for the P2P application and integration landscape, maintaining a clear technical roadmap aligned with the broader technology strategy.
* Lead solution design and technical delivery for enhancements across ERP solutions, procurement workflows, invoice processing, supplier onboarding and partner digital integrations.
* Translate business requirements into pragmatic, secure and supportable technical designs within agreed enterprise architecture and engineering standards.
* Remain hands-on with solution analysis, design reviews, integration troubleshooting, code and configuration reviews, and the resolution of complex production issues.
* Design and improve API, event-driven, EDI and data integration patterns supporting internal systems and external partners.
* Build reusable integration and partner-onboarding patterns that improve delivery speed, consistency, transaction traceability and reconciliation.
* Improve observability across the P2P estate through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, runbooks and root-cause remediation.
* Identify and deliver practical automation opportunities across P2P workflows, including intelligent document processing, exception handling and AI-assisted operations.
* Coordinate internal engineers, delivery partners and vendors, setting technical direction and assuring the quality, maintainability and supportability of delivered solutions.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement and Operations stakeholders to prioritise work, explain technical options and risks, and support adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Embed security, privacy, resilience and data-governance requirements into solution design and operational practices.
* Coach developers and technical contributors, progressively building the leadership and architecture capability required to take broader ownership of the Core Systems domain.

**Skills and Experience**
=========================

* 8-10 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise applications or systems integration, including at least 2-3 years operating as a Senior Developer or Technical Lead.
* Strong hands-on capability in full stack custom application design, integration engineering and the support of business-critical systems using Python, react.js, node.js and AWS cloud stack.
* Experience with Camunda, Cleo and Netsuite or similar solutions highly desirable.
* Experience working with ERP, finance, procurement or supply-chain platforms and an understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes.
* Experience leading mid-level and junior developers situated on-site and offshore.
* Practical experience with APIs, messaging, ETL, event-driven integration or EDI patterns, including monitoring and production troubleshooting.
* Experience delivering solutions across cloud and SaaS environments using modern software development and release practices.
* Ability to translate business needs into clear solution designs and make sound technical trade-offs within enterprise standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with accountability for seeing issues through from diagnosis to sustainable resolution.
* Confidence working directly with business stakeholders, vendors and delivery partners, supported by clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to lead through influence, coach others and balance hands-on technical work with delivery coordination and stakeholder engagement.
* Tertiary qualification in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Key Stakeholders**
====================

* Within the team: Chief Data & Technology Officer, Core Systems contributors, Data & AI Engineering, Platforms, Digital Resilience and Business Partnering.
* Within the business: Finance, Procurement and Operations stakeholders who own P2P processes, priorities, controls and adoption.
* Delivery partners and vendors: application, implementation, support and integration partners engaged across the P2P estate.
* External partners: suppliers, logistics providers and other connected organisations involved in partner onboarding and transaction flows.

job.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

As a full stack developer in Imaging Platform team, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, delivering and maintaining next generation platform solutions for GE Healthcare Products. This platform includes Kubernetes as microservice orchestrator with different platform services for messaging, database, caching, DICOM, Camera, etc. Requires 3-6 years of hands-on development experience in microservice development using GO or Java, containerization using Kubernetes / Docker on Linux Env, deployment and packaging using helm, Python and Ansible. Responsible for end-to-end software delivery including activities such as feature grooming, requirement analysis, documentation/procedures, technology assessment, implementation, code reviews and formal release activities.  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

job.title: Technical Team Manager @ Pasumai Indhya (TN, IN)
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Technical Lead / Engineering Manager – Cybersecurity & AI Software Development

Company: CRT IT Park Pvt. Ltd.

Job Location: Dindigul, Tamil Nadu

Department: Software Development & Technology

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work From Office

Experience Required: 6–10 Years

Salary: ₹50,000–₹60,000 per month (Negotiable based on experience)

Location Preference: Candidates from Tamil Nadu are preferred.

About the Role

CRT IT Park is seeking an experienced and technically strong Technical Lead / Engineering Manager to lead the development of innovative software products in Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Marketing Automation.

The selected candidate will be responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-based SaaS applications, managing the software development team, making technology decisions, and delivering products from initial planning to successful deployment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Product Development

- Lead end-to-end development of Cybersecurity and AI-powered Marketing SaaS products.

- Design scalable software architecture and oversee frontend, backend, database, and API development.

- Develop secure, multi-tenant applications with subscription-based functionality.

- Manage product development from MVP to production release.

- Ensure software quality, reliability, performance, and scalability.

2. Cybersecurity Software Development

- Lead development of cybersecurity monitoring, vulnerability management, and security assessment applications.

- Build secure dashboards, automated reporting, and security alerting systems.

- Oversee authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure API integrations.

- Implement secure coding standards and application security testing.

- Ensure security practices align with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements.

3. AI-Powered Meta Marketing Software

- Lead development of AI-based marketing analytics and automation software.

- Integrate authorized Meta Facebook and Instagram APIs.

- Build dashboards for advertising performance, campaign analytics, and lead management.

- Develop AI-powered campaign recommendations, lead insights, and marketing reports.

- Oversee CRM integrations, customer follow-up automation, and subscription management.

- Ensure compliance with Meta platform policies and data privacy requirements.

4. Technical Team Management

- Recruit, train, and manage software developers, QA engineers, and cloud/DevOps personnel.

- Assign tasks, monitor productivity, and conduct code reviews.

- Establish development workflows, coding standards, and sprint planning.

- Coordinate with management regarding project requirements, budgets, and timelines.

- Take ownership of technical delivery and team performance.

5. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

- Manage cloud infrastructure using AWS or Microsoft Azure.

- Oversee CI/CD pipelines, deployment, monitoring, backups, and disaster recovery.

- Implement cloud security, access controls, and infrastructure optimization.

- Ensure reliable application hosting and production support.

Required Technical Skills

- Programming: Python, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript

- Frontend: React.js / Next.js

- Backend: FastAPI / Django / NestJS / Express.js

- Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB

- AI Technologies: LLM APIs, AI integrations, prompt engineering, AI workflow automation

- Cybersecurity: OWASP, API Security, IAM, Vulnerability Management, Secure SDLC, SIEM fundamentals

- Marketing Integrations: Meta Marketing API, Graph API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0

- Cloud & DevOps: AWS / Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Git, Linux

- Architecture: REST APIs, Microservices, Multi-Tenant SaaS, System Design

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Minimum 6 years of professional software development experience.

- At least 2 years of technical leadership or engineering team management experience.

- Strong hands-on experience in full-stack application development.

- Experience building and deploying cloud-based SaaS applications.

- Practical knowledge of cybersecurity engineering and AI integrations.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience developing cybersecurity software products.

- Experience integrating Meta advertising and business APIs.

- Experience building AI-powered analytics or automation platforms.

- Familiarity with subscription billing, SaaS product monetization, and scalable architecture.

- Relevant AWS, Azure, or cybersecurity certifications.

Key Performance Indicators

- Successful delivery of product MVPs and production releases.

- Achievement of agreed development milestones.

- Software quality, security, and system availability.

- Technical team productivity and delivery efficiency.

- Cloud infrastructure cost optimization.

- Effective coordination with management and business teams.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to lead the development of new software products.

- Technical ownership and leadership responsibilities.

- Exposure to Cybersecurity, AI, and SaaS product engineering.

- Opportunity to build and manage an in-house technology team.

- Long-term career growth with CRT IT Park.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resume, relevant project experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

Email: crtitparkhr@gmail.com

Subject: Application – Technical Lead / Engineering Manager

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
